Every claim must reference source documents (traceability)
2. Hypotheses require minimum 2 supporting documents
3. All embeddings use same model (384-dim)
4. Document chunks: 500 tokens with 100 token overlap
5. Retrieval precision target: 0.6 at top-5 (92% actual)
6. Analysis reliability score: 0.8-1.0 for RCTs, 0.3-0.5 for case studies
7. Reports must include medical disclaimer" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="570" y="585" width="630" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
1. Every claim must reference source documents (traceability)
2. Hypotheses require minimum 2 supporting documents
3. All embeddings use same model (384-dim)
4. Document chunks: 500 tokens with 100 token overlap
5. Retrieval precision target: 0.6 at top-5 (92% actual)
6. Analysis reliability score: 0.8-1.0 for RCTs, 0.3-0.5 for case studies
7. Reports must include medical disclaimer
